note: Curated subset of early/mid-2016 Indy M1-only sessions from O'Doherty/Cardoso/Makin/Sabes 2020 (Zenodo 3854034). Per the record: 'in most sessions M1 recordings were made alone (96 channels)'. indy_20160630_01 is the NLB'21 mc_rtt benchmark session. The loader (ndt1.data.load_session) enforces width == CORTEX_CHANNEL_COUNT (96) at load time and raises ValueError on any session that is actually 192-channel (M1+S1) — that is the runtime gate; this manifest is the reproducibility record. sha256 is PENDING until the first verified fetch by scripts/download_indy.py, which computes and writes it back.
